description: Search Indeed job listings by keyword and location in 9 countries (us, uk, ca, au, ie, de, fr, nl, sg): title, company, location, salary, job type, benefits, skills, apply link and (with details) the full job description. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/indeed-jobs on your Apify account (about $0.003 per job; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

date_posted_days.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

include_details.description: Add each job's full description. Off = search-card summary only.

location.description: City, state, postcode or "Remote". Empty = whole country.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 30, max 500). Cost scales with this.

query.description: Job title, skill or company, e.g. "react developer".

name: search_indeed_jobs

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search Indeed jobs
